title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
Join United Airlines as a Lead Business Analyst and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Lead Business Analyst with strong expertise in data. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute data projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 2 years of experience as a Lead Business Analyst or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Python, Communication, R, Data Visualization
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: MYR 90,000 – MYR 140,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

title: Lead Event Manager
description:
We are looking for a talented Lead Event Manager to join our dynamic team at Cloudflare. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining general solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of MYR 55,000 – MYR 90,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
GitKraken is seeking a Lead Business Analyst who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Lead Business Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our data capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute data initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 6+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Project Management, Tableau, SQL, Statistics
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: MYR 55,000 – MYR 90,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

Join JetBlue Airline as a Director of Copywriter and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Director of Copywriter with strong expertise in general. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute general projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 5 years of experience as a Director of Copywriter or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Communication, Problem Solving, Leadership, Microsoft Office
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: MYR 140,000 – MYR 200,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

- 100% remote — work from anywhere

- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Lead Graphic Designer
description:
Tesla is seeking a Lead Graphic Designer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Lead Graphic Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our design capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**

- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements

- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 6+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Figma, User Research, Design Systems, Microsoft Office
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: MYR 30,000 – MYR 55,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

Join American Express as a Lead Scrum Master and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Lead Scrum Master with strong expertise in general. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

description:
